name: ceiling look stretch v. 2
description: A standing stretch where you reach up and look toward the ceiling to open the front of the body. It opens the hips and thighs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and slightly back.
Tilt your head back to look at the ceiling while pressing your hips forward.
Keep your core engaged so your lower back is not over-arched.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then relax.
